records.name: Cundinamarca
records.summary:
No Cundinamarca-specific law, enforcement practice or incident finding for trans people appears in the record's surviving sources. The reporting they carry frames what a visitor stands under anywhere in the country: an international daily's investigation (July 2024) documented armed groups in a southern department circulating 'social cleansing' flyers naming trans women, giving them a week to leave, and killing 41 trans women nationally in 2023; a further national report on the same pattern (August 2025) could not be retrieved in full at research time and is carried only as context. A second cited item documents the widely shared killing of a trans woman in a northern city that prompted national alarm (April 2025) — reported in Antioquia, not here.

Nothing in the record marks Cundinamarca as materially safer or more dangerous than that national picture, and the absence of Cundinamarca-specific findings reflects where such violence gets reported, not proven safety.

records.name: Cesar
records.summary:
No Cesar-specific law, enforcement practice or incident finding for trans people appears in the record's surviving sources. The national reporting they carry frames what a visitor stands under anywhere in the country: an international daily's investigation (July 2024) documented armed groups in a southern department circulating 'social cleansing' flyers naming trans women, giving them a week to leave, and killing 41 trans women nationally in 2023; a further national report on the same pattern (August 2025) could not be retrieved in full at research time and is carried only as context. The cited cases concern other departments.

Nothing in the record marks Cesar as materially safer or more dangerous than that national picture. Armed-group territorial control is precisely the condition the 2024 investigation links to the displacement of trans women, parts of Cesar have experienced comparable armed-group presence, and the absence of Cesar-specific findings is weak evidence of safety, not proof of it.
